name: The Kuta Beach Heritage Hotel Bali - Managed by Accor
short_description: A 159-room nautical-themed heritage hotel on Kuta Beach with a rooftop bar/restaurant, a 4.5/5 ALL Rating (329 reviews), and a location 5km from the airport.
ai_summary: The Kuta Beach Heritage Hotel Bali is a 159-room boutique property on the Kuta Beach strip, themed around surfing, fishing, and seafaring heritage. It holds a 4.5/5 ALL Rating from 329 reviews. Facilities include Riva Bar & Restaurant (a rooftop venue with panoramic ocean and sunset views), Waves Restaurant, Aqua Spa, and the H2O Fitness Center, plus meeting rooms and ballrooms for business events. It's roughly 5 km (3 miles) from Ngurah Rai International Airport and close to Beachwalk Mall and Legian Street. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.

pros: 159 rooms with a genuine nautical-heritage design identity, distinct from generic beach-hotel styling
Riva Bar & Restaurant rooftop venue with panoramic ocean/sunset views; close to Beachwalk Mall and Legian Street
cons: Kuta Beach strip location is busy and tourist-dense
